boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented UC Davis places for studying, meeting, taking a break, or exploring campus landscapes.

cards.title: Study between the stacks and the sky
cards.subtitle: Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Bring a reading or laptop for a quiet reset in the library courtyard; use it as a break between indoor study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A light-filled courtyard within Shields Library for focused work or a calm pause.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis Library describes the courtyard as a light-filled study space and a place for a quiet work session or study break.
cards.source_title: New Spaces, New Faces at Shields Library This Fall
cards.access_notes: Located inside Shields Library; use current library building access information before visiting.

cards.title: Keep a late study session contained
cards.subtitle: North side of Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Use your UC Davis student ID at the north-side entrance when you need a dedicated overnight study room near the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A student-ID-accessed study room available around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Shields Library provides this study room with 24-hour access year-round for currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate students using student ID-card entry.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours year-round to currently enrolled undergraduate and graduate students; swipe a student ID at the north-side entrance.

cards.title: Put the group project on a calendar
cards.subtitle: Peter J. Shields Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room ahead for a group session, or scan the room QR code on arrival when an unreserved room is available.
cards.short_summary: Reservable collaboration rooms with drop-in use when unclaimed.
cards.evidence_claim: Student groups have reservation priority; unreserved rooms can be used first-come, first-served, with drop-ins asked to create a reservation by QR code.
cards.source_title: Guidelines for Group Study Room Use at Shields Library
cards.access_notes: Reservations have priority; check the display outside a room and follow posted reservation and courtesy rules.

cards.title: Meet up in the SCC lounge
cards.subtitle: 397 Hutchison Drive
cards.notes: Use the open lounge and study areas for a meeting between classes, then look up the center’s current building hours before you go.
cards.short_summary: A central student-life building with lounge, study, and meeting spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Community Center includes an extended-hours study room, meeting rooms, and open lounge and study space.
cards.access_notes: Regular academic-year building hours are listed by UC Davis Operations and Events Management; check for holiday or summer adjustments.

cards.title: Make the MU a daytime rendezvous point
cards.subtitle: Quad District
cards.notes: Meet a classmate in the union before heading to the Quad, or use its game room and meeting areas during normal building operations.
cards.short_summary: A campus union combining meeting space, a game room, bowling, and the student-run Coffee House.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis identifies the Memorial Union as a main campus recreation center with meeting space, a bowling alley, game room, and Coffee House.
cards.access_notes: Some amenities and meeting rooms may have separate operating or reservation requirements.

cards.title: Walk the edible demonstration beds
cards.subtitle: Robert Mondavi Institute courtyard
cards.notes: Take a short garden walk and read the educational plantings; keep clear of beds and ongoing Learning by Leading work.
cards.short_summary: An edible demonstration garden tended by UC Davis students and volunteers.
cards.evidence_claim: The Good Life Garden has edible demonstration plantings, and Learning by Leading students design, plant, maintain, and harvest its raised beds.
cards.access_notes: Visit as an outdoor garden and respect active garden work and planted areas.

cards.title: Pack a low-key picnic break
cards.subtitle: UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.notes: Use the listed picnic tables for a daylight break, then continue along the Arboretum path rather than feeding campus waterfowl.
cards.short_summary: An Arboretum destination with picnic tables, restrooms, and accessible terrain nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis lists picnic tables and public restrooms at Arboretum Terrace Garden and states there is no charge to visit the Arboretum and Public Garden.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Public Garden is open 24 hours daily; follow campus wildlife rules, including the prohibition on feeding waterfowl.

cards.title: Find the Arboretum’s shaded picnic tables
cards.subtitle: UC Davis Arboretum and Public Garden
cards.notes: Bring a snack or sketchbook to the picnic tables, then follow the main path for a walk, jog, or bike ride around the waterway.
cards.short_summary: A named grove on the Arboretum route with picnic tables nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis lists picnic tables in the Redwood Grove and describes the main Arboretum path as a 3.5-mile loop for walking, jogging, and bicycling.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Public Garden is open 24 hours daily; keep dogs leashed and stay on established paths.

cards.title: Use the west-end lawn for an outdoor pause
cards.subtitle: West end of the UC Davis Arboretum
cards.notes: Meet friends for an informal lawn game or picnic, and leave the space ready for the next group and the surrounding landscape.
cards.short_summary: A west-end Arboretum lawn designated for informal games and picnics.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis states that the lawns near Peter J. Shields Grove are suitable for informal games and picnics.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Public Garden is open 24 hours daily; use the lawn responsibly and observe posted campus rules.

cards.title: Start an east-side Arboretum loop
cards.subtitle: East side of the UC Davis Arboretum
cards.notes: Use this garden as the start of the Arboretum’s east-side walking route, checking the visitor map for the orange loop and parking guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named Arboretum garden and suggested starting point for the east-side loop.
cards.evidence_claim: UC Davis identifies the Arboretum GATEway Garden as the suggested start for the east-side Arboretum loop and provides a visitor map with walking tours.
cards.access_notes: The Arboretum and Public Garden is open 24 hours daily; use the visitor map for route and parking details.
